recommendation: Keep the fix as-is. The authoritative StructureDefinition and datatype already implement the approved model; this small narrative correction prevents implementers from reading the notes as a prohibition on the approved administrative contact address.
issue_request: FHIR-25427 was Published/Persuasive for R5 and requested PractitionerRole support for role-specific administrative addresses that can differ by role or organization and are not necessarily tied to a practicing Location.
initial_application: The element model was previously applied: PractitionerRole.contact is active as 0..* ExtendedContactDetail, e1320848bd removed the deprecated PractitionerRole.telecom while referencing FHIR-25427, and related R5 PA contact commits added the common ExtendedContactDetail approach. The remaining gap was stale PractitionerRole notes text.
additional_context: FHIR-29035 created ExtendedContactDetail with address 0..1, matching the FHIR-25427 resolution caveat about using a new datatype if approved. FHIR-14415 and related PA contact issues show the same datatype was used across provider-directory resources. PA January 2021 minutes repeat the FHIR-25427 use case and contact backbone shape, and no conflicting Zulip evidence was found.
reconciliation: Updated source/practitionerrole/practitionerrole-notes.xml to preserve the Location-vs-role distinction: physical service-location addresses come from referenced Location, while administrative or purpose-specific role addresses can be supplied in PractitionerRole.contact.address.
source_changes: source/practitionerrole/practitionerrole-notes.xml: replaced the stale statement that there is no address on PractitionerRole with text distinguishing top-level service-location addresses from administrative/purpose-specific PractitionerRole.contact.address.

related_jiras.note: Created ExtendedContactDetail with address 0..1, which became the datatype used for PractitionerRole.contact.
Requested purpose-specific contact details for PractitionerRole and related PA resources; later comments say it was implemented using ExtendedContactDetail.
Part of the same R5 PA contact refactor that moved Organization contact fields toward contact details.
